title: Quarterly strategy lattice and interlock playbook for OKR flow
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description: Build a repeatable, lightweight playbook (the 'strategy lattice') to operationalize company-level OKRs into aligned, measurable initiatives across Product, Eng, Design, and GTM. The lattice will standardize: 1) intake and triangulation of proposed initiatives against company priorities; 2) a single initiative contract template with success metrics, ownership, risks, and rollback gates; 3) a weekly interlock cadence and escalation path for cross-functional blockers; and 4) artifacts and dashboards in Console and Confluence for visibility. The goal is to reduce planning friction, eliminate duplicate efforts, and shorten decision cycles for Q2 planning while preserving empowerment at the team level.
acceptance_criteria: A single initiative contract template exists and is adopted by >80% of cross-functional leads for new initiatives
A decision-triage flow and escalation path documented in Confluence with owner and SLAs
Console dashboard prototype showing initiative -> OKR mapping and top-5 cross-team dependencies
Run 2 interlock sessions with Engineering, Product, Design, and Sales using the playbook and capture retrospective feedback
Rollout guide published with a 4-week onboarding checklist for PMs and Eng managers
